title: Small-Scale Experiments: Are We There Yet?
abstract: arXiv:2608.11859v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling laws promised cost-effective experiments; six years later, they have yet to fully deliver. Instead, researchers have found them unreliable at small scales (starting at 4M parameters) and concluded that sizable models cannot be avoided. We show this is not the case: the confounding factor is hyperparameters. Small models are highly sensitive, but hyperparameter sensitivity fades with scale. This small-scale sensitivity makes scaling laws easy to miss because they only emerge on the fully tuned frontier, and reaching that frontier requires an extensive search far beyond what most ever run. By ablating the basic scaling law recipe, we show well-tuned hyperparameters matter more than any other ingredient. Further, we reveal why those hyperparameters become easier to find: as scale increases, the hyperparameter loss surface becomes lower dimensional. translated_title: 小规模实验：我们到了吗？
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.11859v1 公告类型：新 摘要：缩放定律曾承诺成本效益高的实验；六年后，它们尚未完全兑现。相反，研究人员发现它们在小型规模（从4M参数开始）下不可靠，并得出结论认为无法避免较大的模型。我们表明事实并非如此：混淆因素是超参数。小型模型高度敏感，但超参数敏感性随规模增大而减弱。这种小规模敏感性使得缩放定律容易被忽略，因为它们只在完全调优的前沿出现，而达到该前沿需要远超大多数人进行的广泛搜索。通过消融基本缩放定律配方，我们表明调优良好的超参数比任何其他成分都更重要。此外，我们揭示了为什么这些超参数变得更容易找到：随着规模增加，超参数损失曲面维度降低。然而，尽管缩放定律存在于小型模型中，外推会遇到统计问题。
tldr: 本文证明小规模实验中缩放定律的可信度受超参数敏感性影响，且调优超参数比模型大小更关键，并解释了随规模增大超参数优化变易的原因。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that scaling law reliability in small-scale experiments is affected by hyperparameter sensitivity, and well-tuned hyperparameters matter more than model size, explaining why optimization becomes easier as scale increases.
